Coram : S. RAVINDRA BHAT*, DIPANKAR DATTA
HEADNOTES Issue for consideration: Whether there is any right to invoke the Most Favoured Nation (MFN) clause when the third country with which India has entered into a Double Tax Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) was not an Organisation for (OECD) member yet (at the time of entering into such DTAA); and whether the MFN clause is to be given eff ect to automatically or if it is to only come into eff ect after a notifi cation is issued. Income Tax Act, 1961– s.90– Agreement with foreign countries or specifi ed
